name: Dariya
bio: Dariya's primary goal in life is to write (and encourage everyone around to do the same): about environment conservation, neurobiology, her favorite artists Ca7riel and Paco Amoroso, and everything in between! She has a background in environmental science research and works with retractions in academic publishing at Retraction Watch, NYC. You can also find some of her culture analysis pieces here, at The Village Kazakhstan. At any given moment, she is probably daydreaming about travelling, DJing, or her next read.

name: Renata
bio: Renata is passionate about public health, biochemistry, and research. She has been involved in many research projects, including pesticide use regulation in the agrosector of Kazakhstan, soil pollution, and absorption applications. Renata also supports the promotion of Paralympic tennis in Kazakhstan by designing social media content, videos, and presentations for sponsors, helping raise awareness and visibility of inclusive sports.

name: Rassul
school: International Steppe School of Astana · IB Class of 2026
bio: Fully responsible for the development and aesthetics of the website, combining technical precision with thoughtful design. Passionate about engineering and problem-solving, he plans to pursue a career in engineering, where he can turn ideas into functional, well-designed solutions.
